AuthorDetails.Description: Developer focused on useful, editor-friendly digital experiences and integrations.

Title: Web Analytics
Description: Connect web analytics providers and bring site-wide and page-level insights into the Umbraco backoffice.

Screenshots.Caption: Explore visitors, page views, traffic history, popular pages, and referrers from the Analytics section.
Set up Vercel and Plausible connections, confirm shared credentials, and configure reporting from the Settings section.
Understand audience devices and locations alongside provider-supported events and features.
Drill into event activity and compare visitors with total events when supported by the provider.
